executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: The existing office observes sessions but cannot enforce subscription-only execution.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Implement a server-side subscription-only gate before adding managed inference.

scope.target_name: Pixel Office personal subscription-only execution review
model_stack: Codex CLI with managed ChatGPT login

findings.title: Subscription-only execution is not enforced
findings.mechanism: Provider hooks normalize observation events; there is no managed execution eligibility gate.
findings.root_cause: The requested execution capability is not implemented.
findings.recommended_fix: Require validated CLI identity, subscription auth, usable quota and no additional-spend path before every managed task.

findings.title: Codex provider observes rather than dispatches tasks
findings.mechanism: The provider starts a JSONL tailer, with no task/model/effort executor.
findings.root_cause: The provider contract serves animation and lifecycle observation.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a distinct official CLI executor and link its events to the existing runtime.

findings.title: Standalone transport needs protection before accepting execution controls
findings.mechanism: Standalone WebSocket connections skip authentication and lack an Origin gate at this route.
findings.root_cause: The current route was designed around a localhost observation and office-settings interface.
findings.recommended_fix: Authenticate managed controls, enforce allowed origins, validate messages and reject arbitrary shell commands.

findings.title: Dismissing a character is not cancelling or pausing a task
findings.mechanism: closeAgent dismisses observation and removes the agent representation.
findings.root_cause: There is no durable managed task lifecycle or owned process to interrupt.
findings.recommended_fix: Separate observation dismissal from managed cancellation, quota pause and guarded resume.

findings.title: Context gauge does not establish remaining subscription quota
findings.mechanism: The existing context meter derives token occupancy from transcript records.
findings.root_cause: Context occupancy, cumulative usage, subscription quota and billing are different measurements.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep context, measured task usage and provider-reported quota distinct; block strict execution on missing required billing evidence.
